notes: Every URL under /sale/* returned a hard Akamai edge 'Access Denied' 403 (errors.edgesuite.net reference) via direct HTTP (curl_cffi, safari17_2_ios mobile impersonation - the profile that DOES work for /new/* and most category paths) and via Playwright Chromium (both headless and headed, --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled) - tried /sale/, /sale/clearance-sale/, /sale/new-clearance/1, /sale/furniture/1, all 403 at tiers 1-2. Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome) bypassed the block cleanly (as it also did for /special-features/best-sellers/*, see bs56.json) after some session/connector instability (repeated transient 'Chrome extension disconnected' / 'tab not in group' errors mid-session, which self-resolved on retry per the tool's own guidance) and every page below was opened and confirmed as a genuine product listing (working filters, item-count header, 'CATEGORIES RELATED TO CLEARANCE <dept>' footer sections) - not editorial/marketing content. CLEARANCE VS SALE: the site's own taxonomy unambiguously treats this as Clearance, not a generic temporary promotion - every page's on-page heading/breadcrumb reads 'LABOR DAY SALE > CLEARANCE: UP TO 60% OFF > CLEARANCE <DEPT>' (or 'CLEARANCE: UP TO 60% OFF' for the View All parent), page titles are literally 'Up to 60% off Clearance <Dept> | CB2', and the embedded primary-nav JSON (fetched separately via plain, unblocked HTTP on the homepage) names this exact node 'Clearance: Up to 60% off' as a persistent nav entry (not a dated campaign banner like the sibling 'Labor Day Sale' / 'Fall Sale' entries also present in that same nav). Independently, CB2's Constructor.io catalog (ac.cnstrc.com, not Akamai-protected) exposes a 'Special Offers' facet on the broader Sale group with a distinct 'Clearance' value (~393 products) separate from generic 'Sale' (~1600) and 'Set Savings' (~51), corroborating this as a real, separately-tagged merchandising concept rather than a name collision - that Constructor count is NOT used as qty anywhere below (the prior Home-Decor pass for this site found Constructor totals diverge from CB2's own rendered header on this platform). The View All parent (406 Items) and all 8 department children were opened individually via their nav-carousel links (Furniture/Outdoor/Lighting/Rugs/Decor/Bedding & Bath/Tabletop/Holiday & Gifts); children sum to 415 vs. the parent's 406, which is expected minor overlap (a product can sit in more than one department, e.g. an outdoor lounge chair tagged both Outdoor and Furniture) per brief guidance, not an error. Checked: main/mega nav (embedded nav JSON), sitemap-plp.xml, sitemap-supercategory-and-spategory.xml (which surfaced the initial /sale/clearance-sale/ candidate), sitemap-indexable-filters.xml (surfaced /sale/new-clearance/1, a filter-indexed alternate URL not used here since /sale/clearance-sale/ was confirmed as the canonical View All page with the matching nav 'View All' link and correct heading), and each page's own 'SHOP MORE CATEGORIES' carousel. No local-language variant applicable (US site, English only).
